name: Beauty & Wellness
seo: Cebu is cheap for grooming and knows it: haircuts and colour from PHP 300, hour-long massage under PHP 500, nail bars in every mall. Salons, spas, massage, barbers and aesthetic clinics across the city and the resort areas — rated and sorted by district, from walk-in neighbourhood shops to Korean salons and medical skin clinics.

subSeo.Spas: Day spas for massage, scrubs and packages, from mall chains to resort spas.
subSeo.Massage: Hour-long Swedish, Thai and shiatsu massage — most under PHP 500.
subSeo.Salons: Cuts, colour, rebonding, nails and lashes — neighbourhood shops, Korean salons and mall chains.
subSeo.Aesthetics: Skin clinics and medical aesthetics: facials, lasers, slimming and injectables.
subSeo.Barbers: Barbershops for classic cuts, fades, beard trims and hot towels.

items.name: Arjean’s waxing and nail spa
items.address: W9VW+PM6, Moalboal, 6032 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Arjean’s Waxing and Nail Spa offers a warm, welcoming, and professional environment where clients receive exceptionally attentive care. Renowned for her meticulous attention to detail, gentle touch, and expertise in BIAB and gel services, Arjean consistently delivers beautiful, long-lasting nails at very reasonable prices. Practical Tip: Booking is fast and easy via WhatsApp, and the salon is conveniently accessible by tuktuk for visitors in Moalboal.

items.name: Raymonds Barbershop
items.address: W9XC+24X, Panagsama Rd, Moalboal, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Raymond’s Barbershop in Moalboal offers an authentically warm, relaxed open-air experience where guests might even enjoy a cold beer while receiving a meticulous, highly professional haircut. Raymond is a remarkably skilled and attentive barber who delivers top-tier work for an unbeatable 150 PHP. Since his open-shack shop periodically faces typhoon damage, be sure to stop by for a fresh trim and leave a generous tip to help support his local business.

items.name: i BLOOMED Skin & Aesthetic Clinic Cebu
items.address: YELLO HOTEL, Wilson St, Lahug, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: i BLOOMED Skin & Aesthetic Clinic Cebu offers a clean, professional, and wonderfully relaxing atmosphere with exceptionally friendly, knowledgeable staff. Key highlights include highly effective treatments ranging from hair regrowth and acne control to permanent wart removal and radiant facials like the Glacial and Carbon peels. Both local visitors and international travelers praise the clinic for delivering visible, lasting results for skin and scalp care. Practical tip: maximize your appointment by treating yourself to a soothing facial while waiting for scalp numbing cream to take effect.

items.name: M&R Medical Aesthetics and Wellness Center
items.address: Acovil Apartment, Unit 1, Ground Floor, 424 Avelino Morales St, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: M&R Medical Aesthetics and Wellness Center offers a clean, relaxing, and discreet environment where Dr. Mike and Rowi provide exceptionally attentive, personalized, and safety-focused care. Clients praise their educational approach and highly effective results across procedures like PRP hair restoration, natural Botox, sclerotherapy, and weight loss support. For the best experience, feel free to discuss any health conditions or scheduling constraints openly, as the team prioritizes patient wellbeing above all.

items.name: Oliva Massage & Spa
items.address: One Tree Plaza Hotel, R. Duterte St, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Oliva Massage & Spa provides an impeccably clean, serene, and welcoming atmosphere designed for ultimate relaxation. Guests rave about skilled therapists, customized massage pressure, full-back heated packs, and thoughtful touches like complimentary tea and loyalty rewards. For a seamless visit, easily book online or via phone in advance, and prepare for an intense yet rejuvenating steam session if trying their popular Moroccan Bath.
